title: designc eval results file
description: What an eval command writes to the path named by `results` in evals/<id>.yaml. Core.scoreEval and python/designc/evals.py judge it against the eval's thresholds.

metrics.description: Named numbers. Every metric a threshold names must be present, or the eval fails with '<metric> is missing from the results'.

cases.description: How many cases the run scored. A whole number, 0 or more.
